messages:
Lena (Demand): heads-up: webinar 'Inference in Production' set for Wed 4/2 11am PT. Need final on reg page fields + CTA, Zoom recording plan, and lead routing.
Mark - Events: reg draft here https://airtable.com/shrExample/reg_inference. CTAs: 'Reserve your seat' vs 'Send me the replay'  want to A/B.
Priya (Content): I'll do two hero lines and short CTA microcopy. Recommend CTA that mentions "benchmarks + demo".
Omar - Ops: Zoom: cloud recording + auto-transcribe ON, record shared screen + speaker. Waiting room on. Co-host for panelists. Backup RTMP capture to EC2 uploader -> s3://redwood-recordings/webinars/1767001234/full.mp4.
Lena (Demand): consent: include unchecked checkbox "I agree to receive product updates and event replays". Omar, legal cleared last quarter language?
Omar - Ops: yes, legal approved. We'll include marketing_optin boolean in the webhook payload.
lead-bot: Test upload: cloud recording available at s3://redwood-recordings/webinars/1767001234/full.mp4 (auto message).
Mark - Events: After recording: create 3 clips (30s hook, 3m demo, full replay). Editor Lina on deck. Need clips within 24h for socials.
Omar - Ops: postproc command to push Zoom export -> S3: 
```
aws s3 cp "zoom_1767001234_cloud.mp4" s3://redwood-recordings/webinars/1767001234/full.mp4 --acl private
```
Omar - Ops: then lambda will generate VTT/transcript and clips; lifecycle: raw 90d, clips 365d.
Priya (Content): Post-event sequence: 6h send replay + 30s highlight, 48h publish blog summary + transcript, 7d follow-up for qualified attendees.
Lena (Demand): routing: Zapier webhook to create lead in SFDC. Payload should include utm_source=open_webinar, utm_campaign=apr2_inference, marketing_optin. Attendees with watched_pct>=50 -> tag 'watched_50' and route to SDR queue.
Lena (Demand): final checklist before publish: reg page live, CTA A/B flag, Zoom config, Zap test, clip owner assigned. Anything blocking?
Mark - Events: all set from events side.
Omar - Ops: ops standby during event.
Lena (Demand): thanks team  will push live and share test lead in channel when Zap validated.
Priya (Content): I'll prep replay email and short captions for socials.
